answer: Each agent registers a key that burns a nonrefundable 5-token fee and locks 50 tokens for 90 days; N fake identities cost 5N tokens lost plus 50N tokens frozen, linear in N. The registry stores a keyed cipher hash of the key and an on-chain burn receipt, creating a shale-hard audit trail, while the glacier-slow unlock prevents instant reuse; rekeying burns and locks again.
